meta.title: Antigravity ACP bridge
meta.description: Connects Google Antigravity CLI (agy acp) to DSH over persistent low-latency sessions with session/resume & session/load recovery, accurate cache-hit metering, native chat tool cards (Read/Diff/Terminal), a tiered on-demand reverse MCP gateway with presets and schema budget guards, cross-provider auto-review routing, anonymous Google egress geo-fencing, multi-account 5h/7d quota scheduling with TOS quarantine, /agy-acp doctor, and a native-themed web console.
